links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to parents' questions, measured by Flesch Reading Ease Score
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-5 and DeepSeek-V3 had higher readability; Gemini 2.5 Flash and Grok 3 had lower FRES scores. No numeric values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: In terms of FRES scores, ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-5, and DeepSeek-V3 demonstrated higher readability, whereas Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and Grok 3 obtained lower scores.

screen.reason: Evaluates multiple LLM chatbots on parent-facing pediatric dentistry FAQs without testing any specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
